name: Ninja Slashing Simulator🌀⚔️
desc:
Welcome to Ninja Slashing Simulator!

👍 Like Goal: 2,000
NEW CODES OR UPDATES AT 2,000 LIKES!

Become a Ninja and slash through other enemies, battle and fight in this Ninja Simulation game. 

How to Play:
⚔️ Click with your sword to earn Slashes! ⚔️
💰 Sell your slashes for Coins! 💰
🤺 Get better swords with your Coins! 🤺
🤑 Get better Slash Capacity to hold more Slashes at once! 🤑
🔥 Rank up to unlock Godly Upgrades! 🔥

🚨UPDATE LOG🚨
- Game Release!

Go through different adventures, fighting and battling other players in this collector simulator!

A Game by Ninja Simulation.
